components.name: Default Button
components.description: Inverse graphite pill; the primary action.
components.css: .ds-btn{font-family:-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Text', Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif;font-size:13px;font-weight:600;height:34px;padding:0 16px;border:0;border-radius:9999px;cursor:pointer;transition:transform 200ms cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1),filter 200ms;background:#1c1c1e;color:#fff;box-shadow:inset 0 1px 0 rgb(255 255 255/.14),0 1px 2px rgb(0 0 0/.18),0 6px 16px -6px rgb(0 0 0/.35)}.ds-btn:hover{filter:brightness(1.12)}.ds-btn:active{transform:scale(.96)}.ds-btn:focus-visible{outline:2px solid rgb(209 105 136/.7);outline-offset:2px}

components.name: Accent Button
components.description: Blush fill with a tinted glow; the brand-colored action.
components.css: .ds-btn-accent{font-family:-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Text', Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif;font-size:13px;font-weight:600;height:34px;padding:0 16px;border:0;border-radius:9999px;cursor:pointer;transition:transform 200ms cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1),filter 200ms;background:#d16988;color:#1c1c1e;box-shadow:0 0 0 1px rgb(158 59 79/.25),inset 0 1px 0 rgb(255 255 255/.35),0 1px 2px rgb(60 40 0/.16),0 6px 16px -6px rgb(209 105 136/.7)}.ds-btn-accent:hover{filter:brightness(1.04)}.ds-btn-accent:active{transform:scale(.96)}.ds-btn-accent:focus-visible{outline:2px solid rgb(209 105 136/.7);outline-offset:2px}

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Elevated white pill with a half-point rim.
components.css: .ds-btn-sec{font-family:-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Text', Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif;font-size:13px;font-weight:600;height:34px;padding:0 16px;border:0;border-radius:9999px;cursor:pointer;transition:transform 200ms cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1),filter 200ms;background:#fff;color:#1c1c1e;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 .5px rgb(227 220 203/.55),0 1px 2px rgb(40 30 0/.06)}.ds-btn-sec:hover{background:rgb(239 235 226/.6)}.ds-btn-sec:active{transform:scale(.96)}.ds-btn-sec:focus-visible{outline:2px solid rgb(209 105 136/.7);outline-offset:2px}

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Recessed oat well that lifts onto white with an accent halo on focus.
components.css: .ds-input{font-family:-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Text', Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif;font-size:13px;height:34px;width:220px;padding:0 12px;border:0;border-radius:12px;background:#efebe2;color:#1c1c1e;outline:none;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px rgb(227 220 203/.55);transition:background-color 160ms cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1),box-shadow 160ms cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1)}.ds-input::placeholder{color:#8b8478}.ds-input:hover{box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px #e3dccb}.ds-input:focus{background:#fff;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px rgb(209 105 136/.7),0 0 0 1px rgb(209 105 136/.3)}

components.name: Card
components.description: Flat paper with an inset highlight and hairline rim; no outer shadow at rest.
components.html:
Sea glass
Satin, frosted, translucent.
components.css: .ds-card{font-family:-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Text', Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif;width:240px;padding:20px 16px;border-radius:24px;background:#fffdf8;color:#1c1c1e;box-shadow:inset 0 .5px 0 rgb(255 255 255/.55),inset 0 0 0 .5px rgb(118 108 92/.22)}.ds-card-t{font-size:17px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:-.43px}.ds-card-b{font-size:13px;color:#6b6458;margin-top:4px}

components.name: Switch
components.description: 52 by 32 pill; the thumb stretches while pressed.
components.css: .ds-sw input{position:absolute;opacity:0}.ds-sw-t{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;width:52px;height:32px;padding:2px;border-radius:9999px;background:#efebe2;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 .5px #e3dccb;transition:background 300ms cubic-bezier(.3,1.3,.4,1);cursor:pointer}.ds-sw-h{width:28px;height:28px;border-radius:9999px;background:#fff;box-shadow:0 2px 6px rgb(0 0 0/.25);transition:transform 300ms cubic-bezier(.3,1.3,.4,1)}.ds-sw input:checked+.ds-sw-t{background:#248a3d}.ds-sw input:checked+.ds-sw-t .ds-sw-h{transform:translateX(20px)}.ds-sw input:focus-visible+.ds-sw-t{outline:2px solid rgb(209 105 136/.7);outline-offset:2px}

components.name: Glass Menu
components.description: Liquid glass floating surface with lit top rim and layered warm shadows.
components.css: .ds-glass{font-family:-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Text', Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif;font-size:13px;line-height:28px;padding:8px 16px;border-radius:16px;color:#1c1c1e;background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgb(255 255 255/.32),transparent 42%),rgb(243 239 230/.42);backdrop-filter:blur(40px) saturate(180%);box-shadow:inset 0 1px 0 rgb(255 255 255/.85),inset 0 0 0 .5px rgb(118 108 92/.22),0 1px 2px rgb(0 0 0/.06),0 8px 24px -8px rgb(40 30 0/.24)}

narrative.overview:
Passui is what Liquid Glass is to Apple and Material 3 is to Google: a design language for the web, tuned for React apps that should feel like first-party citizens of whatever platform they run on. Its material is sea glass, not polished crystal: smooth, frosted, translucent, satin matte, with a faint salt grain instead of a gloss and a hairline rim instead of a hard border. Warm paper neutrals under calm, slightly desaturated accents.

Motion carries the physical half of the idea: springs give surfaces mass and surface tension. The system respects the person using it: light and dark, text size, Reduce Motion and platform conventions all override decoration.
keyCharacteristics: Warm paper neutrals; the accent whispers into the window ground.
Translucent layers with grain, a lit top rim and a hairline.
Apple's Dynamic Type scale, named as SwiftUI names it.
Compact control scale (26 to 38px), round buttons, 12px fields.
Spring physics for every state change.
Platform aware: data-os switches glass for solid chrome.

rules.name: The Whisper Rule
rules.body: The accent tints the window ground and nothing else.

rules.name: The Role Name Rule
rules.body: Feature code uses named roles, never hex.

rules.name: The Dynamic Type Rule
rules.body: Use text-* tokens, never raw Tailwind sizes.

rules.name: The Grain Over Gloss Rule
rules.body: All glass shares one sea salt grain; polish is a defect.

rules.name: The Rim Not Border Rule
rules.body: Edges are a lit top highlight plus a 0.5px rim, never a 1px border on glass.

dos: Do use named roles for color, text-* Dynamic Type tokens for type, and the 2/4px radius ladder for shape.
Do keep glass matte: grain, a hairline rim and a lit top edge.
Do honor light and dark, text size, Reduce Motion and data-os conventions.
Do take every string from the app.
donts: Don't use liquid glass gloss or crystal sparkle.
Don't use raw hex, pixel font sizes or ad hoc shadows in feature code.
Don't introduce @base-ui/react or shadcn primitives as runtime dependencies.
Don't tint grounds other than the window ground with the accent.
Don't put a 1px solid border around glass.
Don't use cold blue-black dark surfaces.
